TeammateIdle was re-checked once from Claude Code on the web with the hook configuration byte-identical to 190b04e and did not fire. It is recorded as UNAVAILABLE_IN_CLAUDE_CODE_WEB, treated as optional, and is not a master-run blocker; see documented_limitations and .claude/HOOKS_README.md section 1.1.

overall=PASS is reached through live_event_tests=PASS_WITH_DOCUMENTED_LIMITATION, which the validator accepts only when the limitation names a registered hook event, matches its live_checks entry, carries a reason, and lists fallback controls.

documented_limitations.reason: Claude Code on the web / remote execution (CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT=remote, CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE=true) at version 2.1.220 with agent teams enabled never emits TeammateIdle for Agent-tool teammates. The gate is registered and its handler is fully covered by the static suite; the host simply never calls it here.
documented_limitations.evidence: Host debug log /tmp/claude-code.log (CLAUDE_CODE_DEBUG=true), which names every hook Claude Code invokes. Window bytes 90452-105260 (121 lines) covering a named teammate that owned task 'tmp-teammate-idle-name' (status in_progress, required artifact absent) and went idle unimpeded: zero occurrences of 'Teammate' or 'TeammateIdle'. Detector validated in the same window by a positive control -- the teammate's denied Write into .claude/ was recorded as "Hook PreToolUse:Write (PreToolUse) success" with permissionDecision deny. All hook invocations in the window reconcile against known tool calls (6 Bash dispatches -> 6 allow lines, 1 Write -> 1 named denial, Agent is not in the PreToolUse matcher), so the event did not fire silently either.
documented_limitations.not_a_missing_feature: The 2.1.220 binary contains the literal string 'TeammateIdle' 21 times, so this is a missing emission path on this surface rather than an absent feature.
documented_limitations.residual_gap: An unprotected teammate type that abandons work without claiming completion is caught by TASK_GRAPH.json ownership and lead review, not by a hook.
fallback_controls: TaskCompleted (live-verified at 190b04e): blocks marking a task complete without its declared artifacts and a passing current-SHA receipt -- abandonment that tries to look like completion is stopped here
SubagentStop (live-verified at 190b04e): blocks implementation-agent and test-watchdog from stopping on an incomplete contract, covering the protected writer roles
Stop (live-verified at 190b04e): blocks the lead from ending the run with unmet gates, so an abandoned task cannot leave the run quietly

Explicit task ownership in TASK_GRAPH.json plus lead-agent review of every teammate return: ownership is declared before work starts, so unfinished work stays visible in durable state regardless of whether any hook fired
